FBI Charges US Resident in Canadian School Shooting Plot

The FBI has charged a U.S. resident in connection with the Tumbler Ridge school shooting in Canada. Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) Assistant Commissioner stated that the U.S. resident's actions "helped facilitate" the attack. The New York Times reported that the FBI has charged an American in the plot behind the shooting. The Toronto Star explored the alleged role of the American co-conspirator.
